newsitem.title: USA: Pepperidge Farm to recall two products.
newsitem.headline: Pepperidge Farm to recall two products.

text.p: Pepperidge Farm Inc said on Friday it was recalling limited lots of its fat free pretzel mix and its seasoned snack mix because the products may contain peanuts not listed on the labels.
The company said it was recalling the 9.25 oz and 1.5 oz size of the pretzel mix, and the 9.25 oz package of the seasoned snack mix.
The products could cause an allergic reaction among people who are sensitive to peanuts.
Pepperidge Farm is a unit of Campbell Soup Co.
